summary: Rampersand backs ambitious founders from Australia and New Zealand from day zero, wherever they are building. Its homepage describes inception, pre-seed and seed cheques into ANZ founders including the global diaspora, a lead or co-lead role with deep follow-on reserves, more than $100,000,000 deployed, and a concentration in AI-native software, vertical AI and deep tech, with locations in Sydney, Melbourne and San Francisco. Founders pitch through the site. Cheque size and a street address are not stated.

investmentEvidence.fact: The homepage links a Substack investment note on Cor. The round and date are not shown on the homepage.

sources.title: Homepage: ANZ founder focus, stages, role, sectors, locations and pitch link
